basic_profile.bio: I'm a high school senior from California, currently navigating the college application process. I'm passionate about computer science and anime, and I love spending my free time reading webcomics, especially Eeveelution Squad. I also enjoy exploring Vietnamese cuisine and culture. In terms of dislikes, I'm not a fan of overly strict rules or complex bureaucratic processes. I usually browse Reddit during the evenings, mostly after school. I'm single and focusing on my studies and hobbies right now.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a decent understanding of the college application process, mostly through online research and discussions with peers. My knowledge of computer science comes from a mix of high school classes and self-study through online resources and tutorials.
